title: CJ's last fight with Big Smoke in GTA San Andreas
subject: cj
description:
Should CJ have forgiven Big Smoke? 👇

How Carl Johnson's story ends with Big Smoke and Officer Tenpenny. Spoilers for the ending of GTA San Andreas.

scenes.text: CJ's last enemies were his oldest friend and a cop.
When the charges against Tenpenny were dropped, Los Santos burned in riots.
In the final mission, End of the Line, CJ fought up Big Smoke's crack palace.
At the top, Smoke admitted the money and power got to him. He didn't walk out.
Tenpenny grabbed the cash and stole a fire truck, with Sweet hanging off the ladder.
The truck flew off a bridge into Grove Street, and Tenpenny died where CJ grew up.
CJ never had to pull the trigger. He just walked back inside his mother's house.
